choose.when:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_id = #{roleId} AND gt.subject_type = 'DEPT'
AND ( d.dept_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR d.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
choose.otherwise:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_post p ON p.id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_id = #{roleId} AND gt.subject_type = 'POST'
AND ( p.post_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR p.post_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )

choose.when:
SELECT u.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.username) AS label FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_id = #{roleId} AND gt.subject_type = 'USER'
AND ( u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND u.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY u.username
